reasonBody: I started Label Studio because Android apps for compact label printers often make designing, saving and reusing labels unnecessarily difficult. This open-source project aims to make label design accessible across devices and support more printers.

Welke verbinding kan vanuit de browser?: Which connections work from a browser?
Je browser biedt Web Bluetooth. Verbinde: Your browser offers Web Bluetooth. You can connect BLE printers for which Label Studio has a print protocol.
Safari en Chrome op iPhone/iPad onderste: Safari and Chrome on iPhone/iPad do not support Web Bluetooth. Try Bluefy as a BLE browser. Compatibility varies and is not guaranteed.
Web Bluetooth voor BLE is hier niet besc: Web Bluetooth for BLE is unavailable here. Try Chrome on Android, Windows or macOS and open the site via HTTPS.
Bluetooth Classic: in geschikte Chrome-v: Bluetooth Classic can use Web Serial with RFCOMM/SPP in supported Chrome versions after OS pairing. This differs from BLE and is not implemented in Label Studio. A Bluetooth logo alone does not prove support.
Wifi / LAN: mogelijk met een geschikte H: Wi-Fi / LAN needs a suitable HTTP(S) or WebSocket API, browser/network permission and a known print protocol. Websites cannot open arbitrary TCP ports (such as 9100) or discover all LAN printers. A local print bridge is usually needed without a web API. Label Studio does not implement this route yet.
Bluetooth protocol implemented · hardwar: Bluetooth protocol implemented · hardware certification pending

Hardwaregegevens uit een communityregist: Hardware data from a community registry; no driver or physical certification in Label Studio. Model and firmware variants may differ.
Waarden uit het bestaande projectprofiel: Values from the existing project profile; not physically verified. Do not confuse with the 96-dot Fichero D11s.
Printkop van 96 dots (circa 12 mm) gemet: 96-dot print head (about 12 mm) measured in community research; media width is not printable width.
Bronnen beschrijven P12-firmware met L11: Sources describe P12 firmware with L11 and modern 1F framing. Label Studio only has the existing L11 profile; a name or photo does not prove firmware compatibility. P11/LP90 are search/protocol aliases, not confirmed identical devices.
203 dpi en 12–15 mm volgens fabrikant. D: Manufacturer states 203 dpi and 12–15 mm. One community source confirms 96 dots, another calls it inferred. Therefore no confirmed print head width is listed.
Familie-aliassen zoals P7 en M1 zijn gee: Family aliases such as P7 and M1 do not prove identical casing or firmware.
M60 is described as an X2 white label. That source assumes 384 dots; it is not a measurement. X2 photos are not used as M60 photos.
AiYin D11s; Action-artikel 3212141, stan: AiYin D11s; Action item 3212141, standard 14 × 30 mm. The GitHub reference links this specific item to the model.
BLE- en Classic-hardware gedocumenteerd: BLE and Classic hardware documented by the source; AiYin printing is not built into Label Studio. USB-C is only evidenced for charging.
Nog geen uniek artikelnummer of betrouwb: No unique item number or reliable model reference yet. The existing 300-dpi / 50 × 15 mm choice is only a design preset, not a confirmed printer specification.
Dit is D11-H: niet D11, D11s of de AiYin: This is D11-H, not D11, D11s or AiYin/Fichero D11s. No automatic driver matching by the D11 name.
Fabrikant vermeldt papier van 6 / 12 / 1: Manufacturer lists 6 / 12 / 14 / 15 mm media; 96 dots comes from the community table. A catalog profile is not an implemented D/Q driver.
De fabrikant bevestigt 203 dpi en papier: Manufacturer confirms 203 dpi and 20–50 mm media width. This does not mean all 50 mm is printable.
GitHub-projecten spreken elkaar tegen: 3: GitHub projects conflict: 344 versus 384 dots. Print head width remains unknown and this choice is design only.
DYMO vermeldt USB/LAN op de 550 Turbo en: DYMO lists USB/LAN on the 550 Turbo and 5XL: LAN means Ethernet, not Wi-Fi. Selecting a catalog entry does not enable a browser driver.
De 450 Duo heeft een afzonderlijk D1-tap: The 450 Duo has a separate D1 tape mechanism; this profile only covers the LW label roll.
